label: Positive correlated-report four-cell probability profile
definition: Reports supplies 0<prior<1 and one Row under H and notH. A Row has four strictly positive rational masses (both positive reports, only A, only B, neither), summing to one within each hypothesis. A and B are sums of matching cells, joint is the both cell. Each event is passed to the existing Comparison with the same prior. ConditionalH/V divide joint by B marginal; pooledConditional divides prior-mixture joint by prior-mixture B. ConditionalIndependent asserts the joint equals the product of marginals separately within H and notH; UnconditionalIndependent asserts that product equality in their prior mixture. Report events concern receipt of positive reports, not report truth; H and notH are exhaustive and incompatible by the stipulated binary interpretation.
